memos.description: Work found outside the quest's scope: written down for the Chancellor instead of done in place.
The assignee contests a note of the verdict that sent its run back: which note, why, and the evidence. A second judge reads it beside that verdict; once per verdict, and the second verdict is final.

The assignee contests its quest's description: it is wrong, or another way gives what it promises better. What the description says, what the assignee proposes, why, and the evidence. The quest waits as on a question while its author (the Chancellor, or the mage of its plan) accepts and rewrites it, rejects it, or hands it to the owner; one per quest, and a second goes to the owner.
